DeepSeek Harness desktop Web Host configuration.
These values are read at startup and are user-specific — edit your local copy, and be careful not to commit a private domain. Restart the app to apply; no repackaging needed.
 - webPort: fixed loopback port the tunnel must point to. Env override DSH_DESKTOP_WEB_PORT. 0 = OS-assigned.
 - trustedHosts: authorities the /api browser-trust fence accepts (your public domain). Env override DSH_DESKTOP_TRUSTED_HOSTS (comma-separated).
